sources.title: Way-too-early Super Bowl LXI favorites, offseason storylines and five teams to watch
sources.description: Seattle caps the 2025 season with a Lombardi Trophy, but the race for next year is already underway. A first look at Super Bowl LXI favorites, cap-rich teams poised to improve and the biggest offseason questions across the league.
